rules.D_COMP_BREAK: Cross above all 5/10/20/60/120 daily SMAs; prior 20 sessions any CV<=.05
rules.M_COMP_BREAK: Completed month crosses above all 5/10/20/30/40/60 month SMAs; preceding three completed CV<=.05
rules.M_SUPPORT100: Declining completed month, trailing 12 completed month high DD<=-.20, prior SMA100 rising, previous close > prior SMA100*1.05, current close within ±5% prior SMA100
rules.D_HIGH252: Close strictly greater than prior 252 closing highs
rules.D_MATURE: First consecutive day 21 below SMA60, trailing60 return<=0, trailing120 DD<=-.20
rules.D_RECLAIM20: Cross above/equal daily SMA20 with trailing120 DD<=-.15
rules.W_RECLAIM20: Completed week cross above/equal SMA20, previous completed week below, prior 52-week DD<=-.15

outcomes.comparison: eligible non-event same rule; not matched
outcomes.nonoverlap: greedy by asset/rule/horizon/group, next signal strictly after previous exit

limitations: new proxy definitions not exact original cafe rules
no corporate-action or PIT calendar certification
